title: Elemental Hit of the Spectrum Deadeye

stages.title: Act 1
stages.goal: Take Rain of Arrows after The Siren’s Cadence. Use a linked bow and follow Firkz’s guide for the opening levels.

stages.title: Act 6 (Start)
stages.goal: Keep Rain of Arrows and replace resistances after Act 5.

stages.title: Start of Maps (Bow)
stages.goal: Use Lightning Arrow with a fast elemental bow while preparing the swap.

stages.title: Endgame · Spectrum swap
stages.goal: Swap to the transfigured gem with a strong elemental bow. Check ailment uptime against the target you plan to farm.

overview:
Level with Rain of Arrows. Use Lightning Arrow while you work on a fast elemental bow and the Spectrum gem.

Source guide by itzkinetik: https://pobarchives.com/build/3CmtBf8q
Original PoB: https://pobb.in/l1RYyK_Zoqn-
Campaign reference by Firkz Gaming: https://pobarchives.com/build/bkVLJWMg
Campaign PoB: https://pobb.in/7ogW_TFuoV2D

PoB uses 3.29 simulation data. See the creator guide for assumptions and any additional stages.
